identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase Ⅱ Study of RC108 in Combination With Furmonertinib for the First-line Treatment of EGFR-Mutated Combined MET-Positive Unresectable Locally Advanced or Recurrent Metastatic NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Open, Controlled, Multicenter Phase II Clinical Study of RC108 in Combination With Furmonertinib Versus Furmonertinib for the First-Line Treatment of EGFR-Mutated Combined MET-Positive Unresectable Locally Advanced or Recurrent Metastatic NSCLC

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Evaluate the efficacy and safety of RC108 in combination with Furmonertinib against Furmonertinib for treatment of EGFR mutation combined with MET-positive unresectable locally advanced or recurrent metastatic NSCLC
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Primary objective: Evaluate the efficacy and safety of RC108 in combination with Furmonertinib against Furmonertinib for treatment of EGFR mutation combined with MET-positive unresectable locally advanced or recurrent metastatic NSCLC Secondary objective: Evaluate the pharmacokinetic and immunogenicity characteristics of RC108 in combination with Furmonertinib

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with adverse events (AEs)
secondaryOutcomes.description: An AE is any untoward medical occurrence in a participant, temporally associated with the use of study treatment, whether or not considered related to the study treatment.
